scope: New wording and behavioral constraints in previously exposed repositories. Authored, non-exhaustive labels, not independent users/agent outcomes. Four behavioral queries and four scope controls per split. Validation not opened until candidate freeze; no product tuning after validation. Old questions diagnostic only.

acceptance.no_regression: No aggregate file/visible/inspection losses on either split; no scoped individual file/visible loss; explicit-scope responses identical; record all unscoped individual losses; same primary candidate-stage generation. Fixed reproduction must pass.
acceptance.latency: p95 <= max(100 ms, 1.5x baseline); old 68-query/five-method ranking baseline and thresholds unchanged.
acceptance.resources: Private arm caches, cached sources only, one process at a time, max512MiB disk/1.5GiB RSS/180sec per process; no models or cloud.
acceptance.limitation: Change penalty interpretation only for high-confidence behavioral verb leads. Preserve task_terms, retrieval tokens, snippets and expansion. Unknown or noun-based requirements retain legacy interpretation.
